name: 金阁寺现存舍利殿
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu colored companion heritage plate. Image 1 is the EXACT final black ink line plate of jp_kinkaku; preserve its silhouette, framing, roof count, openings, architectural details and all major contours. Image 2 is a documentary photograph of this same Japanese monument for ACTUAL material colors. Image 3 is the project's matte colored architectural illustration style sample ONLY; its black background and warm gold palette are NOT to be copied. Color Image 1 faithfully as an elegant museum architectural illustration. Material observations: Natural dark brown timber and pale plaster on the lower level; genuine warm metallic gold-leaf on the second and third storeys, muted charcoal-brown cypress-shingle roofs, a restrained golden phoenix finial. Gold must stay on the real gilded upper facade, not the whole building. Keep thin charcoal ink contours visible, with restrained matte mineral pigment planes and only very light texture INSIDE solid building surfaces. Do not add features, people, trees, labels or neighboring structures. Retain Image 1's composition and aspect ratio. Entire exterior background and truly open spaces must be perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF with no black ground, gray haze, gradient, paper texture, shadow, glow, checkerboard or transparency. This is colorization, not redesign.
material_observations: 一层深棕木与淡色壁面；二、三层金箔；暗褐柿葺屋顶和金色凤凰。

technical_review.note: 已查看原稿与实拍材料色；不等于用户视觉验收。依照现存复建体，金箔色可能因光照与修缮而变化。
